Last Tuesday, while we were reviewing the numbers, their director called me. He said that another company had offered them a better deal. I told him that our data is more complete, and that we have already worked with three banks in their region. Right now, we are preparing a new offer. We are going to send it on Friday. If they accept, we will start in January.
